learning: The changes made are based on the need to enhance line-following performance as indicated by the telemetry data.
notes: Updated geometry to improve line-following performance by increasing body width and wheel track, and adjusting sensor size.
rationale: The telemetry data indicates that the robot is struggling with line loss events (1 recorded) and has a max error of 0.061271, suggesting that the current geometry is not optimal for line-following. To address this, I have updated the geometry by increasing the body width to 0.1m and the wheel track to 0.12m, which should enhance stability and line-following capability. Additionally, I have set the sensor size to 0.012m to improve detection accuracy. I expect these changes to reduce line loss events and improve overall progress in future trials.
